task_instance: Write a pseudo-formal long-horizon task brief (definitions, exact success predicate, non-counting outcomes, auditor checklist, artifact-based reporting contract, audit-gated return condition, effort floor, contamination guard) for a bounded root-cause/fix task on a small sample Python repo (a rounding bug in pricing.apply_discount causing 2 failing pytest tests), score the brief against the skill's 9-question pre-launch rubric, then actually execute the brief end-to-end (reproduce the failure, diagnose the defect, implement the fix, rerun tests, run the auditor's independent verification case) to confirm the brief is followable and its return condition is genuinely satisfiable.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/muratcankoylan__agent-skills-for-context-engineering__long-horizon-prompting . Created sample_repo/pricing.py (buggy apply_discount using floor division) and sample_repo/test_pricing.py (3 tests, 2 initially failing on a half-cent rounding case). Ran `python3 -m pytest sample_repo/test_pricing.py -q` -> '2 failed, 1 passed' (saved to test_output_before_fix.txt), confirming a real reproducible regression. Wrote task_brief.md implementing every brief-anatomy block from the skill (DEFINITIONS with degenerate cases, TASK as one exact success predicate, 6-item DOES NOT COUNT list, 5-item auditor VERIFICATION checklist, artifact-based reporting contract, audit-gated RETURN CONDITION, EFFORT floor, CONTAMINATION guard; ORCHESTRATION correctly omitted since this is a single bounded fix, not a parallel search). Wrote pre_launch_evaluation.md scoring the brief against the skill's 9 pre-launch questions (8/9 fully satisfied, 1 N/A for orchestration at this scale, 1 correctly flagged as harness-owned/advisory-only per the skill's own guidance). Then actually acted as the agent under the brief: diagnosed the defect (price_cents*discount_pct // 100 truncates instead of rounding half-up), applied the fix `(price_cents*discount_pct+50)//100` in sample_repo/pricing.py, and reran `python3 -m pytest sample_repo/test_pricing.py -q` -> '3 passed in 0.23s' (saved to test_output_after_fix.txt). Verified the auditor's independent, non-literal check case apply_discount(15,50)==7 (matches round-half-up of 7.5) and no-regression case apply_discount(1000,10)==900, plus degenerate cases (0 price, 0%, 100% discount) all behave correctly, confirming the brief's non-counting list (especially the float round-half-to-even trap and the literal-special-case trap) actually pre-blocked the tempting shortcuts and the return condition was genuinely, verifiably satisfied. All work stayed local shell/file operations inside the work directory; no MCP/connector tools, no network, no credentials were used or needed.
